display_name: Phase1 源训练样本受限分类边界可达性反事实
description: 对固定源样本中 DURA 与 clean 基座判断不一致的记录，研究受限波形改动是否能到达 clean 判断。

data.representation: Fixed Phase1 source clean and precomputed original DURA native IQ
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; no TX labels in restorer training
data.actual_training_labels: No TX labels; source clean teacher pseudo-class is privileged diagnostic only

permissions.regime: Phase1 source clean and DURA native, frozen Tri-SIG-TIME only
permissions.claim_scope: Source-only target-directed waveform counterfactual; not deployable or accuracy

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed original DURA native source IQ and frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL E50
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact field metadata, DURA SHA256 and source ID/native IQ alignment
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Exact Phase1 original DURA and trained anchored field
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed source IDs and original teacher mismatch; no model update or target selection

metrics_plan.targets_ref: source teacher class, not TX truth

notes: 固定 512 个 Phase1 源训练 ID（L128/U384），在源视图 01 与 20 各一次；仅处理 DURA 基座判断与 clean 基座判断不一致的记录。
每条记录以 clean 基座类别为目标，DURA 输出为起点，输入梯度下降 12 步；L2 范数分别约束在 clean L2 的 2% 和 5%，步长为半径的四分之一。
clean 目标类别及 clean 范数在实际推理中不可用，因此这是带源数据特权信息的不可部署反事实，并非新模型或准确率上界。
冻结 Tri-SIG-TIME，不更新模型；只读原 DURA native IQ 与源 clean、scene、state、role，不读取 TX、V 或测试 IQ。
源样本已用于训练；此前 Phase1 开发测试已观察。目标到达可由非物理扰动产生，不代表语义保真或泛化。

rows.method: Frozen teacher target-directed projected input gradients
rows.purpose: Check whether small source-only targeted perturbations can cross difficult teacher decision boundaries
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source rows and views; deterministic fixed model
rows.optimizer: input-only normalized gradient, 12 steps per epsilon; frozen network
